I’m running for San Mateo City Council District 3 to ensure our city is a place where everyone can thrive – creating a community that is affordable, safe and sustainable for generations to come. Let's move San Mateo forward!
​
GET INVOLVED
## About
As a mother and entrepreneur, I understand the challenges families and local businesses face every day. I’m proudly running for City Council District 3 to put my experience to work for you.
​
Real change is powered by people like you and me – neighbors who care deeply about the future of our city and all of its residents.
Read More
## Priorities
### Affordable Housing
Too many of our friends, neighbors, and caregivers are being forced to move away due to skyrocketing housing costs. San Mateo County is at the center of the housing crisis, and we need balanced solutions so that the people who work here can afford to live here.
### Safe Streets & Parks
I believe local government’s top responsibility is keeping its community safe. I haven’t just talked about safety; I’ve delivered it. After three tragic pedestrian deaths, I founded Safe Streets for Everyone to organize our community in support of pedestrian and bicycle safety. When neighbors told me the Sunnybrae Park playground was falling into disrepair, I helped parents get an unsafe play structure replaced.
### Sustainable Infrastructure
From wildfire smoke to stormwater flooding, San Mateans are already feeling the impacts of climate change. We must act now to adapt and lessen these impacts, creating a strong foundation of livability for our children and grandchildren.

Endorsements for Seema Patel San Mateo City Council District 3
I'm proud to have the support of elected officials, community leaders, and neighbors across San Mateo and the Bay Area in the 2026 election for City Council District 3. These endorsements reflect a shared belief that San Mateo deserves leadership rooted in action – not just words.
As Chair of the Planning Commission for the City of San Mateo, I've spent years working alongside many of these leaders on the issues that matter most to our community: affordable housing, safe streets, and sustainable infrastructure. From state legislators and our County Board of Supervisors to school board members, local business owners, and the neighbors I see at the park – this growing coalition is proof that our campaign is powered by community.
​
This broad support means the world to me, and it sends a clear message: San Mateo is ready for leadership that listens, acts, and delivers. If you'd like to add your name, I'd be honored to have you join us.
